description: This file defines the LeaveConfigurationService class within the OrangeHRM leave plugin. It extends a generic ConfigService to provide specific configuration retrieval and setting methods related to leave policies such as entitlement consumption, work schedule implementation, leave inclusion in balance calculations, and leave period settings.

classes.name: LeaveConfigurationService
classes.description: A service class providing configuration management specifically for leave-related settings in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getLeaveEntitlementConsumptionStrategy
methods.description: Retrieves the leave entitlement consumption strategy setting.

methods.name: getWorkScheduleImplementation
methods.description: Retrieves the implementation setting for leave work schedule.

methods.name: includePendingLeaveInBalance
methods.description: Checks if pending leave is included in leave balance calculation.

methods.name: setLeavePeriodStatus
methods.description: Sets the leave period status with an provided integer value.

methods.name: getLeavePeriodStatus
methods.description: Gets the current leave period status.

methods.name: setLeavePeriodDefined
methods.description: Sets whether the leave period has been defined.

methods.name: isLeavePeriodDefined
methods.description: Checks if the leave period has been set.
